I am writing to provide a comprehensive medical overview of Matthew Rogers, who was seen in my practice on May 09, 2025, for a URI. Matthew's current health status and medical history are below.

On October 07, 2024, Matthew visited my practice to address his Cocaine use disorder. His blood pressure at that time was 122/74 mmHg, and he weighed 112 pounds. Matthew continues to do well in his addiction management plan and has maintained sobriety for the past nine years and four months.

In August 05, 20Z3, Matthew presented with an ankle sprain. His blood pressure was 123/63 mmHg and he weighed 119 pounds at that visit. Matthew has since recovered from the sprain and has not reported any related issues.

On January 03, 2023, Matthew was seen for his Cocaine use disorder. His blood pressure was 136/69 mmHg and he weighed 113 pounds. Matthew is doing well in his recovery, maintaining sobriety and adhering to treatment plan.

In June 02, 2022, Matthew visited for a rash. His pressure was 125/69 mmHg and he weighed 124 pounds. At that time, Matthew was also diagnosed with Cocaine use disorder (substance: cocaine), with his last use dating back to 9.4 years ago.

Matthew’s lifestyle and social habits also warrant attention. He exercises regularly, running 3-4 times a week. Regarding his substance use history, Matthew has a history of tobacco use. He was a former cigarette smoker, having smoked 10 cigarettes per day, but he quit on July 19, 2013. Currently, Matthew consumes 10 alcoholic drinks per week.

Matthew’s overall health appears to be in standing, with stable vital signs and weight within normal ranges for his age
